cases.sentence: Пусть он поставит быка у входа в шатер собрания перед ___.
cases.translation: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) takes the instrumental case for indicating presentation.

cases.sentence: Пусть помазанный священник возьмет кровь быка и внесет в ___.
cases.translation: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it into the tent.
cases.explain: The verb внесет в (bring into) takes accusative case with в indicating movement.

cases.sentence: Пусть он обмакнет палец в кровь и покропит ею семь раз перед ___.
cases.translation: He shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the veil.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) takes the instrumental case for location.

cases.sentence: Пусть священник помажет кровью рога жертвенника для возжигания благовоний перед ___ в шатре собрания.
cases.translation: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of incense before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Остальную кровь быка пусть выльет к основанию жертвенника для всесожжения у входа в ___.
cases.translation: He shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
cases.explain: The preposition в with accusative indicates movement or location in relation to the entrance.

cases.sentence: Пусть он вынесет молодого быка за ___ на чистое место, куда высыпают пепел.
cases.translation: He shall carry the bull outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out.
cases.explain: The preposition за with accusative indicates movement outside of a location.

cases.sentence: Если весь народ израильский согрешит по неведению, сделав то, что запрещено в каком-либо исповелении Господних, даже если народ сам того не знает, он ___.
cases.translation: If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, they are guilty.
cases.explain: After the verb 'is' (understood from context), the predicate adjective takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть священник совершит отпущение за ___, и он будет прощен.
cases.translation: The priest shall make atonement for his sin, and he will be forgiven.
cases.explain: The preposition за (for) can take the genitive case when referring to the sin being atoned for.

reading.ru: Если кто-то согрешит по неведению, сделав то, что запрещено в какой-либо из Господних заповедей, он виновен.
reading.question: When is someone considered guilty of sin according to this passage?
options: If they sin unintentionally in doing what is forbidden in God's commandments
Only if others witness the sin
If they fail to make an offering
reading.correct: If they sin unintentionally in doing what is forbidden in God's commandments
reading.explain: The text clearly states that sin committed unintentionally in doing what is forbidden is guilty.

reading.ru: Если согрешит помазанный священник, наводя вину на народ, то пусть согрешивший приведет Господу молодого быка без изъяна в жертву за свой грех.
reading.question: What offering was required if the anointed priest sinned unintentionally?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states the priest should bring a young bull without defect for his sin offering.

reading.ru: Пусть помазанный священник возьмет кровь быка и внесет в шатер собрания.
reading.question: What did the anointed priest do with the blood of the bull?
options: He poured it at the base of the altar
He took it and brought it into the Tent of Meeting
He sprinkled it on the people
He applied it only to the horns of the altar
reading.correct: He took it and brought it into the Tent of Meeting
reading.explain: The text states the priest took the blood of the bull and brought it into the Tent of Meeting.

reading.ru: Если весь народ израильский согрешит по неведению, сделав то, что запрещено в каком-либо исповелении Господних, даже если народ сам того не знает, он виновен.
reading.question: What happens if the whole congregation sins unintentionally?
options: They are not guilty because they didn't know
They remain guilty even if they don't know about the sin
They must wait for the annual Day of Atonement
reading.correct: They remain guilty even if they don't know about the sin
reading.explain: The text states that even if the congregation doesn't know they have sinned, they are still guilty.

reading.ru: Пусть старейшины общества возложат руки на голову быка и заколют его перед Господом.
reading.question: What was the role of the elders in the sin offering for the whole congregation?
options: They brought the offering to the priest
They laid hands on the head of the bull and killed it before the Lord
They sprinkled the blood on the altar
They received the blessing from the priest
reading.correct: They laid hands on the head of the bull and killed it before the Lord
reading.explain: The text explicitly describes the elders laying their hands on the bull's head and killing it before the Lord.

reading.ru: Когда откроется ему грех, который он совершил, он должен принести за него в жертву козу без изъяна.
reading.question: What offering was required if a ruler sinned unintentionally?
reading.explain: The text states that if a ruler's sin is revealed to him, he must bring a male goat without defect for a sin offering.
